    23	|--------|--------|

    27	| Partial update | **PATCH** |

    32	
    33	### G2 — Naming Conventions
    34	- All route path segments must use **snake_case** (e.g. `/search_results`, not `/searchResults`)
    35	- Collection endpoints use plural nouns (e.g. `/users`, not `/user`)
    36	- Python function names must mirror their route in snake_case

    40	- Every route must be prefixed with `/api/v1/`
    41	- Correct: `GET /api/v1/users`, `POST /api/v1/users`, `DELETE /api/v1/users/<id>`
    42	- Incorrect: `GET /users`, `GET /api/users`, `GET /v1/users`
    43

    54	**Location**: `create_user()` route decorator

    66	# After (CORRECT):

    69	```

    75	**Location**: Search/filter endpoint — route `/createPost` and function `createPost`

    83	# Before (WRONG):
    84	@app.route("/users/createPost", methods=["GET"])
    85	def createPost():
    86	
    87	# After (CORRECT):
    88	@app.route("/api/v1/users/search", methods=["GET"])
    89	def search_users():
    90	```
    91	
    92	---
    93	
    94	### VIOLATION V3 — Missing `/api/v1/` Prefix (breaks G3)
    95	
    96	**Problem**: All routes currently use prefix `"/users"` instead of `/api/v1/users`.
